cohort: The study included 917 premature infants with birth weight less than 1500 g.
finding: NLR, MLR, and SIRI values were significantly higher in very low birth weight infants with early onset sepsis (EOS) compared to controls, with SIRI demonstrating a good predictive value for EOS (AUC = 0.803).
cross-section timing: At the time of diagnosis or suspicion of early onset neonatal sepsis
